user.title: Intex Spa
user.description: Sign in with the same account you use in the Intex Link app. The device id, encryption key and network address are looked up for you.

data_description.country_code: The dialling code of the country the account was registered in, without the plus sign. Romania is 40, Germany 49, the United Kingdom 44.
data_description.password: Used once, to read your spa's device key. It is not stored.

device.title: Choose a spa
device.description: The account holds more than one device.

host.title: Network address
host.description: {name} did not announce itself on the network, so its address could not be found automatically. Enter it manually, and reserve it in your router so it does not change.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer accepts its stored key, which happens when the spa is re-paired in the Intex Link app. Sign in to fetch the new one. Nothing from this is kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Intex service. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Wrong email, password or country code.
error.no_devices: No devices on that account. If your spa's control panel code does not contain TY, it does not have a Tuya module and this integration cannot talk to it.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.
error.wrong_account: Those credentials work, but that account does not own this spa.
error.invalid_host: That is not a valid IP address.

abort.already_configured: This spa has already been added.

temperature_out_of_range.message: The spa only accepts a target between {min} and {max} degrees Fahrenheit.

unverified_model.title: This spa model has not been verified
unverified_model.description: Your spa reports product id `{product}`, which this integration has not been tested against. It should still work - entities were created from the data points it reports: {points}. If something is missing or behaves oddly, please open an issue quoting that product id.

unsupported_layout.title: This spa does not look like a PureSpa
unsupported_layout.description: Product id `{product}` reported these data points: {points}. The ones needed for basic control are not among them, so most entities will be missing. Please open an issue with that list - it is exactly what is needed to add support.
